_comment: Live config for Duckdoku Blast. Copy this file into the jvea03/duckdoku-privacy repo as config.json; it is then served at https://jvea03.github.io/duckdoku-privacy/config.json, which is RemoteConfig.CONFIG_URL. Every value below is the shipped default, so publishing it as-is changes nothing: edit a number, commit, and players pick it up at their next launch (and after an hour away). Only keys in Tunables.DEFAULTS are accepted, with the right type and within 0 to 20x the default; anything else is ignored and a broken file changes nothing.
